title: Jaagorgal mawngal Joomiraawo
intro: Aɗa tawa hoore maa e leydi kaawisaaji ɓooyɗi e wahyu luggiɗiiɗo. Laamɗo doole, jokkondirɗo e noddaango ngo o sikkaano, ummii e laawol ngol waylata laawol daɗndo mum e iimanaagal leñol mum. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa ooɗoo limre mawnde?
clues: Mi laamiima laamu mbelngu, mbelngu e jawdi keewndi e jappeere mawnde.
Min e leñol am min ndewatnoo ko ɓanndu asamaan, min ngoongɗini ko kañum woni joom men, hay so tawii miɗo joginoo sikkitaare e ɓernde am.
Nelaaɗo keeriiɗo, colli, yettinii kam ɓataake, ina noddi mi e leñol am ngam ɗooftaade Alla gooto.
Mi naamndii wasiyaaji am, baawɗi semmbe, no njaabotoo-mi ndeeɗoo nulal ngal meeɗaa yiyeede.
Mi fellitii neldude nelduɗo ɓataake oo dokkal ngal, miɗo sikki miɗo foti ƴeewde doole makko e anniyaaji makko.
Nde ngar-mi ndee, mi haawniima e galle laamorɗo mo 6uu6ol mum waɗi gila e gilaasi, ina feeñi no 6uu6ol ndiyam nii, ko ndeen kadi mi anndini 6uu6ol am e Joomiraacfo tagoore ndee fof.
arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verse: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great (23) (27:23)
